title: feat: add crypto-only Pollen checkout
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a direct crypto-only Stripe checkout beside the selected Pollen pack's regular checkout. Crypto stays in USD without currency conversion or card-only options.
- Fixes checkout creation by sending explicit crypto payment methods separately from the regular payment-method configuration.
- Refines top-up controls with a stable-width Buy button, a one-line "Pay with Crypto" link with Stripe reassurance, and a left-aligned mobile auto-top-up switch and pack label.
- Adds Stripe's crypto symbol to the footer payment logos, with source attribution.
- Clarifies that crypto payments follow the same refund policy and approved refunds return through Stripe as stablecoins to the original wallet.

Validation: focused Stripe integration tests, Enter TypeScript checks, Biome, desktop/mobile browser checks, Stripe sandbox crypto checkout on staging (main + this branch).

gist.headline: A new path to Pollen
gist.blurb: Pollen packs get a crypto checkout alongside the regular one. Same pack, different path through Stripe.
gist.summary: Adds a separate Stripe crypto checkout for Pollen packs that stays in USD, sends explicit crypto payment methods, and clarifies that approved refunds return as stablecoins to the original wallet.
gist.impact: People topping up Pollen get a Pay with Crypto option beside regular checkout, with no currency conversion or card-only options in the crypto flow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict two friendly paths from a Pollen pack to a cozy checkout terminal: a regular payment path and a coin-marked crypto path. Polli, wearing a tiny coin-patterned scarf, points toward the crypto path; a small code-plant and prominent lime-green glow keep the scene rooted in the pollinations garden.
